name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly during a university internship with a local karting team. Initially tasked with basic bookkeeping, he quickly became fascinated by the complex financial dynamics that underpin racing operations. He saw firsthand how strategic financial planning could provide a competitive edge, sparking a deep interest in the field.

Following graduation, Wei Jian joined Eurofarma RC, driven by their commitment to fostering young talent. His approach as a finance controller is meticulous and data-driven, constantly seeking innovative ways to optimize budget allocation and secure sponsorship opportunities. Wei Jian possesses a sharp analytical mind and a knack for identifying cost-saving measures without compromising performance, making him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Wei Jian apart is his proactive approach to problem-solving and his unyielding ambition to see Eurofarma RC succeed. He consistently goes above and beyond, proactively researching industry trends and exploring new revenue streams to fuel the team's growth. Wei Jian's calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to see the big picture make him a rising star in the motorsport finance world.
